sources.title: Squarefull numbers in arithmetic progression II
sources.finding: Confirms unweighted squarefull AP layers and explicit quadratic/cubic torsion-character selection.

sources.title: Variance of square-full integers in short intervals and arithmetic progressions
sources.finding: Reviews current unweighted squarefull AP and generalized squarefull literature; no I_r weight located.

sources.title: Smooth squarefree and square-full integers in arithmetic progressions
sources.finding: Studies smoothness and least squarefull representatives, not the margin-interior weight.

sources.title: Conditional Results for a Class of Arithmetic Functions: a variant of H. L. Montgomery and R. C. Vaughan's method
sources.finding: Treats zeta(as)zeta(bs)/zeta(cs)^k classes and generalized squarefull examples; no exact character-twisted I_r theorem located.

sources.title: Multiplicative functions in arithmetic progressions
sources.finding: The stated theory concerns multiplicative functions valued in or on the unit disk; I_r is sparse and unbounded.

sources.title: Remarks on the Selberg--Delange method
sources.finding: Confirms broad classical mean-value transfer from zeta-type factorizations; no exact multi-layer residue-class theorem located.
